title: Commission tiers: a lookup with nested IF
objective: Look up a value from a tier table with nested IF and absolute references (the v0 substitute for an approximate-match lookup).
instructions: In C2:C5, return each rep's commission rate from the tier table in F1:G4. Use the highest tier whose "Sales from" amount the rep has reached. Refer to the table cells (for example $G$3) instead of typing the rates.
hints: Put a second IF in the value_if_false part for the middle tier, and use $G$2 as the last fallback.
The $ signs keep the table references fixed when you reuse the formula on the next row; B2 changes to B3.
